# Module notes

<!-- provenance -->
> **AI-written interpretation** of the code at commit `a50f11c`, based on the extracted facts (`integrations.md`, `change-impact.md`, `architecture.md`, `data-model.md`, `graph.json`) and sampled source. Verify details against the code.


One sentence on what each busy folder, and each file to be careful with, is for. Written from names only (paths, function and class names), not from reading the code.

## Folders

- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/application`: Handles ship overview rebuilding and rerunning concurrent commands with results.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/application/errors`: Contains error classes for application layer conflicts and issues.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/application/ports`: Defines event journals and ship history projections for ports.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/domain`: Manages ship and cargo domain logic including voyages and locations.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/domain/commands`: Issues commands for managing voyages and ship activities.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/domain/errors`: Defines error handling for domain-specific events and payloads.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/domain/events`: Handles serialization and upcasting of domain events like ship arrivals.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/shared/domain`: Includes shared domain entities like Id and Name with constraints.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/shared/errors`: Provides base error options and examples for shared error handling.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/application/use-cases/dock-ship`: Defines use cases and data transfer objects for docking ships.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/adapters/outbound/persistence/errors`: Handles persistence-related errors in the outbound adapter layer.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/shared/utils`: Provides utility functions for object and text manipulation.

## Files to be careful with

- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/adapters/inbound/http/controllers/divert-ship.ts`: Controls HTTP requests for diverting ships.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/adapters/inbound/http/controllers/dock-ship.ts`: Handles HTTP requests for docking ships.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/adapters/inbound/http/controllers/plan-voyage.ts`: Manages HTTP requests for planning voyages.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/adapters/outbound/projections/sqlite-ship-overview.ts`: Projects ship overviews and manages SQLite database interactions.
- `modules/ships-n-cargo/scripts/error-architecture.ts`: Diagnoses and configures error architecture options.
